messages:
ashley: Heads-up: PR #4123 has two snippet issues (batching example wrong arg order) and one dead link. Urgent for v0.9.2 docs cut. Can someone pick up a quick patch? https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4123 :eyes:
phil: I can take the snippet fixes. Which files?
ashley: docs/optimize/batching.md and docs/optimize/kv-prefetch.md. Batching example uses `batch_size` where it should be `max_batch_bytes`. Also kv-prefetch link points to old route /sdk/examples -> 404.
phil: Got it. I'll update the code block and swap the link to /sdk/examples-v2. Quick question: should we keep the Python and Node snippets in sync or prefer Python canonical?
sofia: Docs team prefers both but Python canonical. If it's time-boxed, fix Python and add TODO for Node sync. I'll file a follow-up issue.
phil: Patch ready locally. Snippet before: ```python
client.generate(model='x', batch_size=32, prompt='hello')
``` after: ```python
client.generate(model='x', max_batch_bytes=1024, prompt='hello')
``` Will open PR shortly.
docs-bot: deploy preview build started for branch phil/docs/4123-snippet-fix — preview URL: https://deploy-preview-4123.docs.redwood.ai :construction:
ashley: Nice. Also add a short note about quant profile defaults for small-seq workloads in the same batch doc? We've had confusion in support.
phil: I can add a 2-line note: 'For short sequences (<64 tokens), prefer smaller max_batch_bytes and aggressive kv-prefetch to avoid OOM and latency spikes.' OK to include?
kai: SGTM. Also add a link to the Optimize Toolkit 'short-seq heuristics' page (internal) — /optimize/shortseq-heuristics. phil, I'll DM the internal link if you need it.
phil: Added note and swapped link. Opened PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4130 (fastpatch -> 4123). Please review.
sofia: Reviewing now. Quick nits: add inline example for JS call using `maxBatchBytes` camelCase for consistency.
phil: Added JS example. PTAL.
ashley: :thumbsup: If CI preview is green, let's merge before EOD and cherry-pick to v0.9.2 branch. phil, can you also add changelog entry under docs/CHANGELOG.md ?
phil: Yep. I'll merge after deploy preview passes and add changelog entry.
docs-bot: deploy preview build passed — link: https://deploy-preview-4123.docs.redwood.ai :white_check_mark:
ashley: Merged and cherry-picked to release branch. Thanks everyone. I'll send a short note in #docs-release later.
